polityNote: Federal Republic of Cameroon from the reunification of 1961-10-01, United Republic from 1972, Republic of Cameroon from 1984. Units are drawn as actually administered. Atoms: the 360 arrondissements of geoBoundaries CMR ADM3 (OpenStreetMap/Wambacher 2017, ODbL), so that the disputed places are withheld as their own arrondissements: the four Bakassi arrondissements to 2008-08-14, Mora and Kolofata (Narki) to 2004-07-13, and the five lakeside arrondissements of Logone-et-Chari (Darak and the Lake Chad villages) 1976–2004. Every province is a union of whole arrondissements; the department changes of 1963–1995 (statoids ycm) all stay inside provinces. Rewritten from the Natural Earth atoms on 2026-10-06 because NE had one atom per province, which forced whole provinces to be withheld for the Bakassi and Lake Chad windows. ① Arrondissement-to-province assignment by area: identical majority on Natural Earth and on the geoBoundaries ADM1 layer for all 360 atoms (2 below 0.8: Tonga 0.78 Ouest, Limbé III 0.62 Sud-Ouest). Province areas of 1976 (statoids, with the withheld arrondissements added back) vs the unions: Centre-Sud 117,500 vs 116,408 km² (0.991); Est 111,200 vs 110,479 (0.994); Littoral 20,800 vs 20,257 (0.974); Ouest 13,500 vs 14,015 (1.038); Nord-Ouest 17,812 vs 17,493 (0.982); Sud-Ouest 24,571 vs 24,742 (1.007); Nord 164,300 vs 165,000 (1.004).
